evidence.quote: Software Engineering Master's thesis Mohammad Rafi Uddin 2026 Turku
This thesis investigates the impact of AI-assisted coding tools and low-code development platforms on software developer productivity, code quality, and perceived trust and usability
AI assistance accelerated pattern-rich work, with the experiment showing roughly 57.5% faster task completion and about 71% fewer compile errors
All 3,945 commits between 2025-05-15 and 2026-04-24 were exported using git log --all --numstat with author identity, date, subject, and per-file insertion/deletion counts.
Code duplication was measured with jscpd 4.x at the default threshold (50 tokens / 5 lines).
The survey was administered online by using the Webropol platform and was disseminated via various channels such as coding communities, social media, and professional networks.
